_note: Fixture config for scripts/tests/fixtures/budgets: a one-line ceiling on SKILL.md.
_expected_name_note: The frontmatter name is compared against this value, not against the directory name, so a fixture tree under scripts/tests/fixtures/<rule>/ does not fail the frontmatter rule merely for living in a differently named directory.

encoding._crlf_note: The committed blobs are LF. core.autocrlf=true gives a Windows worktree CRLF, so the rule normalises CRLF for analysis instead of failing on it: forbidding it would be red on the maintainer's machine and green in CI.
